description: Test specifications for session key utility functions in a TypeScript project, using the Vitest testing framework. The file contains test cases for functions related to session key classification, parsing, and validation.

methods.name: classifySessionKeyShape
methods.description: Classifies the shape of a session key string into categories such as 'agent', 'malformed_agent', 'legacy_or_alias', or 'missing'.

methods.name: getSubagentDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of subagents in a session key, based on the number of subagent segments.

methods.name: isCronSessionKey
methods.description: Checks whether a given session key corresponds to a cron job session.

methods.name: deriveSessionChatType
methods.description: Derives the chat type ('direct', 'group', 'channel', or 'unknown') from a session key.

methods.name: parseThreadSessionSuffix
methods.description: Parses the session key to determine if it contains thread or topic suffixes and returns the base session key and thread id.

methods.name: resolveThreadParentSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves the parent session key from a threaded session key.

methods.name: parseAgentSessionKey
methods.description: Parses an agent session key into its components, case-insensitive.

methods.name: toAgentStoreSessionKey
methods.description: Returns a canonical session key for agent storage, avoiding duplication of prefixes.

methods.name: isValidAgentId
methods.description: Validates whether an agent ID string conforms to expected rules.
